profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Discover Financial Services
profile.summary:
Passionate and solution-oriented Computer Scientist with a wide variety of professional experiences. Adept at motivating self and others. I determine to seek out a thoughtful & engaging career that will allow for continuous self-growth.

Experience: Angular 8, Typescript, Javascript, SCSS, SASS, Java, C, C++, Python, MySQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed an Angular 8 web application for health care services provider.
•	Followed Pair Programming, XP and TDD programming practices.
•	Improved quality of code with high coverage unit tests using Jasmine and Karma.

positions.title: Security Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Worked with the Global Security Organization to help find a new solution or change existing methods so that the Security team will work more efficiently with less cost.
•	Helped with the process of moving from a currently-using IDS to another IDS that will help CDK save more than 150k. 
•	Created a Splunk dashboard that helps with visualizing the different types of AWS account users and their proportion. The dashboard also helps with investigating future unusual incidents such as a sudden increase or decease in a type of users and abusing root privileges.
•	Validated an existing data provided by a threat intelligent application and then modified it to fit with CDK environment. Performing data analytics on over 1TB of logs to find security incidents. The result of the modification was 5x faster than before and contained no false positive. 
•	Changed an existing way of running a vulnerability assessment tool to reduce unnecessary scans. Generated xlsx and pdf reports, which contained information such as vulnerability score, risk score, and remedies whenever there was a new scan. Created an email template to send the reports to the right group of people.
•	Helped with the process of moving from a currently-paying DLP tool to a free DLP tool by create a reporting tool that the new DLP tool did not have. Extensive usage of Python to automate parsing and data reporting.

positions.title: Dentist Assistant
positions.description:
•    Used dental computer program, prepared tools, handed instruments and suctioned for different type of procedures.
•    Kept the instruments and work place sanitized.
•    Provided a professional and friendly atmosphere to the patients.
